axi_vfifo_raw_wr.summary: Virtual-FIFO write side: segmented input data crosses clock domains through a gray-pointer dual-clock FIFO, then a burst controller issues AXI write bursts into a ring buffer, tracking start/finish pointers via a response-length FIFO.

blocks.name: Input CDC FIFO
blocks.description: Segmented dual-clock FIFO with gray-coded pointer synchronization.

anchors.name: write_fifo_seg[*].seg_mem_data
anchors.why: Per-segment dual-clock input FIFO RAM buffering write data.

anchors.name: write_fifo_seg[*].seg_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Input-clock write pointer of segment FIFO.

anchors.name: write_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: System-clock read pointer of input FIFO.

anchors.name: write_fifo_wr_ptr_sync_reg
anchors.why: Write pointer synchronized via gray code into system clock domain.

anchors.name: write_fifo_occupancy_reg
anchors.why: Input FIFO occupancy; sizes bursts and triggers full-burst start.

anchors.name: write_fifo_seg[*].seg_full
anchors.why: Segment FIFO full; deasserts input_ready.

anchors.name: write_fifo_empty
anchors.why: Input FIFO empty; blocks FIFO read and output valid.

anchors.name: input_valid_int_reg
anchors.why: FIFO output word valid; gates burst start, timeout and data transfer.

anchors.name: input_read_en
anchors.why: Consumes FIFO output word into AXI write data.

anchors.name: input_data
anchors.why: Segmented input data written into FIFO RAM.

anchors.name: input_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment input valid writing segment FIFO.

anchors.name: input_ready
anchors.why: Per-segment ready when FIFO not full and not in reset.

anchors.name: input_watermark
anchors.why: Input FIFO above watermark or in reset.

blocks.name: Reset synchronizer
blocks.description: Synchronizes cfg_reset into the input clock domain.

anchors.name: input_rst_out
anchors.why: Synchronized cfg_reset in input clock domain; clears input pointers.

blocks.name: Burst controller
blocks.description: Decides burst start, length and timeout; streams W beats.

anchors.name: wr_burst_reg
anchors.why: Burst-active state: idle issues AW, active streams W beats.

anchors.name: wr_burst_len_reg
anchors.why: Remaining beats in current burst; sets wlast and ends burst.

anchors.name: wr_timeout_count_reg
anchors.why: Partial-burst timeout countdown.

anchors.name: wr_timeout_reg
anchors.why: Timeout flag allowing partial burst start.

anchors.name: fifo_full_wr_blk_adj_reg
anchors.why: Ring buffer has no space for next block; blocks burst start.

anchors.name: cfg_enable
anchors.why: Enables burst generation.

blocks.name: Ring pointer tracking
blocks.description: Write start/finish pointers of the virtual FIFO ring buffer.

anchors.name: wr_start_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Ring-buffer write start pointer; forms AXI address and occupancy.

anchors.name: wr_finish_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Write completion pointer advanced on each B response.

anchors.name: wr_start_ptr_blk_adj_reg
anchors.why: Block-aligned start pointer for full-space check.

anchors.name: rd_finish_ptr_in
anchors.why: Read-side finish pointer used for occupancy and full computation.

anchors.name: cfg_fifo_base_addr
anchors.why: Ring buffer base address added to burst address.

blocks.name: AXI write master
blocks.description: Registered AXI AW and W channel outputs.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid for each new burst.

anchors.name: m_axi_awready
anchors.why: AXI AW ready clears address valid.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Burst address: base plus masked start pointer.

anchors.name: m_axi_awlen
anchors.why: Burst length output.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data from FIFO output.

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write data valid.

anchors.name: m_axi_wready
anchors.why: AXI W ready advancing data transfer.

anchors.name: m_axi_wlast
anchors.why: Last beat of burst.

blocks.name: Response length FIFO
blocks.description: Queues burst lengths to advance finish pointer on B responses.

anchors.name: resp_fifo_burst_len
anchors.why: FIFO of outstanding burst lengths for finish-pointer update.

anchors.name: resp_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Response FIFO write pointer.

anchors.name: resp_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Response FIFO read pointer, advanced on bvalid.

anchors.name: resp_fifo_we_reg
anchors.why: Writes burst length into response FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid advancing finish pointer.

blocks.name: Status
blocks.description: Occupancy, empty, full and write-active status.

anchors.name: sts_fifo_occupancy
anchors.why: Virtual FIFO occupancy output.

anchors.name: sts_write_active
anchors.why: Writes in progress or outstanding.

axi_vfifo_raw_rd.summary: Virtual-FIFO read side: issues AXI read bursts from DRAM between read and write pointers, buffers returned data in per-segment dual-clock FIFOs with gray-coded pointer sync, and streams segments out.

blocks.name: AXI read burst generator
blocks.description: Computes burst address/length from DRAM pointers, timeout for partial bursts, issues AR.

anchors.name: rd_start_ptr_reg
anchors.why: DRAM read-issue pointer; sets burst address and length versus write finish pointer.

anchors.name: rd_finish_ptr_reg
anchors.why: DRAM read-completion pointer, advanced per accepted read beat.

anchors.name: wr_finish_ptr_in
anchors.why: Write-side finish pointer; data available in DRAM determines burst length and issue.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid, raised when a full burst or timeout burst is issued.

anchors.name: m_axi_arready
anchors.why: AXI read address ready; clears arvalid.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Burst address: base plus masked read start pointer.

anchors.name: m_axi_arlen
anchors.why: Burst length from computed rd_burst_len.

anchors.name: rd_burst_len
anchors.why: Burst length: up to burst boundary or remaining available data.

anchors.name: rd_timeout_count_reg
anchors.why: Countdown before issuing a partial burst when data is pending.

anchors.name: rd_timeout_reg
anchors.why: Partial-burst timeout expired; allows short burst issue.

anchors.name: cfg_enable
anchors.why: Enables issuing new read bursts.

anchors.name: cfg_fifo_base_addr
anchors.why: DRAM FIFO base address added to masked read pointer.

blocks.name: Outstanding read counter
blocks.description: Tracks issued but not yet returned read beats.

anchors.name: rd_outstanding_reg
anchors.why: Outstanding read beats: incremented by burst issue, decremented per read beat.

anchors.name: sts_read_active
anchors.why: Read active status when outstanding beats nonzero.

blocks.name: Read data FIFO write side
blocks.description: Writes AXI read data into segment FIFO memories; full and space-reservation logic.

anchors.name: read_fifo_seg[*].seg_mem_data
anchors.why: Per-segment dual-clock FIFO RAM buffering AXI read data.

anchors.name: read_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Local FIFO write pointer addressing segment memories on each read beat.

anchors.name: read_fifo_wr_ptr_gray_reg
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer for crossing into output clock domain and full check.

anchors.name: read_fifo_full
anchors.why: Local FIFO full; blocks rready and FIFO writes.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data written into per-segment FIFO memories.

anchors.name: m_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid; with rready writes FIFO and advances finish pointer.

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Read data ready when local FIFO not full or under cfg reset.

anchors.name: read_fifo_occupancy_lookahead_reg
anchors.why: Occupancy including issued bursts; gates new burst issue for FIFO space.

anchors.name: read_fifo_read_start_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Reserved FIFO pointer advanced by burst length when a burst is issued.

anchors.name: read_fifo_read_start_en
anchors.why: Burst-issue enable reserving FIFO space.

blocks.name: Pointer CDC synchronizers
blocks.description: Gray-code pointer synchronizers between clk and output_clk domains.

anchors.name: read_fifo_wr_ptr_gray_sync_2_reg
anchors.why: Write pointer synchronized to output clock; used for segment empty.

anchors.name: read_fifo_rd_ptr_sync_reg
anchors.why: Read pointer synchronized back to clk, binary-decoded for occupancy.

blocks.name: Segment output read
blocks.description: Per-segment reads in output clock domain driving output data/valid.

anchors.name: read_fifo_seg[*].seg_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Per-segment read pointer in output clock domain addressing segment memory.

anchors.name: read_fifo_seg[*].seg_empty
anchors.why: Segment FIFO empty; blocks segment read.

anchors.name: read_fifo_seg[*].seg_rd_data_reg
anchors.why: Segment output data register read from FIFO memory.

anchors.name: read_fifo_seg[*].seg_rd_data_valid_reg
anchors.why: Segment output valid register driving output_valid.

anchors.name: output_data
anchors.why: Segmented output data from per-segment read registers.

anchors.name: output_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment output valid.

anchors.name: output_ready
anchors.why: Per-segment downstream ready; allows next FIFO read.

blocks.name: Output reset synchronizer
blocks.description: Synchronizes cfg_reset into output clock domain as output_rst_out.

anchors.name: rst_sync_3_reg
anchors.why: cfg_reset synchronized into output clock; resets output-side pointers.

axi_vfifo_raw.summary: AXI virtual FIFO top: write engine streams segmented input into a DRAM ring buffer, read engine streams it back out, exchanging pointers; a small reset/enable controller latches base/mask config.

blocks.name: Write engine
blocks.description: Write instance moving input segments into DRAM ring via AXI writes.

anchors.name: input_data
anchors.why: Segmented input data passed to write engine on input_clk.

anchors.name: input_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment input valid to write engine.

anchors.name: input_ready
anchors.why: Per-segment input ready from write engine FIFOs.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI write burst address generated by write engine.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid from write engine.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data stream from write engine to memory.

anchors.name: wr_finish_ptr
anchors.why: Write-complete pointer from write engine telling read engine available data.

anchors.name: wr_start_ptr
anchors.why: Write issue pointer exported from write engine to read engine.

anchors.name: sts_fifo_occupancy
anchors.why: FIFO occupancy count reported by write engine.

anchors.name: sts_write_active
anchors.why: Write engine busy; holds FIFO reset until flushed.

anchors.name: input_watermark
anchors.why: Input FIFO watermark indication from write engine.

blocks.name: Read engine
blocks.description: Read instance fetching ring data via AXI reads and streaming output segments.

anchors.name: output_data
anchors.why: Segmented output data streamed from read engine.

anchors.name: output_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment output valid from read engine.

anchors.name: output_ready
anchors.why: Downstream ready into read engine output FIFOs.

anchors.name: output_ctrl_data
anchors.why: Optional control output data, disabled by CTRL_OUT_EN default.

anchors.name: output_ctrl_valid
anchors.why: Optional control output valid from read engine.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI read burst address generated by read engine.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid from read engine.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data returned to read engine buffers.

anchors.name: rd_finish_ptr
anchors.why: Read-complete pointer from read engine freeing space for writes.

anchors.name: rd_start_ptr
anchors.why: Read issue pointer exported from read engine to write engine.

anchors.name: sts_read_active
anchors.why: Read engine busy; holds FIFO reset until flushed.

blocks.name: Reset and enable control
blocks.description: Synchronizes reset requests, flushes engines, latches base/mask and enables FIFO.

anchors.name: fifo_enable_reg
anchors.why: FIFO active flag enabling both engines; set on cfg_enable, cleared in reset.

anchors.name: fifo_base_addr_reg
anchors.why: Latched ring buffer base address fed to both engines.

anchors.name: fifo_size_mask_reg
anchors.why: Latched ring buffer size mask fed to both engines.

anchors.name: cfg_enable
anchors.why: Software enable request; latches config and sets enable flag.

anchors.name: cfg_reset
anchors.why: Software reset request triggering FIFO flush and reset sync.

anchors.name: cfg_fifo_base_addr
anchors.why: Configured base address input, masked into base register.

anchors.name: rst_sync_3_reg
anchors.why: Final stage of reset request synchronizer asserting FIFO reset.

anchors.name: rst_req_out
anchors.why: OR of all reset sources exported for cross-instance reset sync.

anchors.name: sts_active
anchors.why: Active status output copying enable register.
